issue.title: Not sorted interfaces in config_db.json file

failure.body:
**Description**

Not sorted interface in config_db.json file. In the previous builds, the configuration file was readable and sorted but for now it like some randomly generated and not sorted content, it is very hard to read, search and troubleshoot something manually there.

**Steps to reproduce the issue:**
1. Run more /etc/sonic/config_db.json
2. Observer unsorted interfaces in the configuration file

**Describe the results you received:**
`
 "PORT": {
        "Ethernet180": {  <----------------first port should be Ethernet0 (etp1)
            "alias": "etp46",
            "admin_status": "up",
            "mtu": "9100",
            "lanes": "180,181,182,183",
            "index": "46"
        },

        "Ethernet8": {
            "alias": "etp3",
            "admin_status": "up",
            "mtu": "9100",
            "lanes": "8,9,10,11",
            "index": "3"
        },

        "Ethernet44": {
            "alias": "etp12",
            "admin_status": "up",
            "mtu": "9100",
            "lanes": "44,45,46,47",
            "index": "12"
        },

        "Ethernet184": {
            "alias": "etp47",
            "admin_status": "up",
            "mtu": "9100",
            "lanes": "184,185,186,187",
            "index": "47"
        },
        "Ethernet188": {
            "alias": "etp48",
            "admin_status": "up",
            "mtu": "9100",
            "lanes": "188,189,190,191",
            "index": "48"
        },
        "Ethernet0": {
            "alias": "etp1",
            "admin_status": "up",
            "mtu": "9100",
            "lanes": "0,1,2,3",
            "index": "1"
        },
`

**Describe the results you expected:**
Expected that interfaces will be sorted like before.

**Additional information you deem important (e.g. issue happens only occasionally):**

resolution.title: [config] Sort Config Db When Saving
resolution.description:
#### What I did

Restored cfggen sort method of json data and used it to
sort config db before saving.

closes: https://github.com/Azure/sonic-buildimage/issues/6328
signed-off-by: Tamer Ahmed <<EMAIL>>

Restored cfggen sorting method
